description: Change a person's name, job title, e-mail addresses or phone numbers, or a company's name, website, industry or description, on a record in the customer's CRM. The record must have been read with get_crm_record first, and only e-mail addresses and numbers that read showed can be removed.

entity_type.description: contact or lead, exactly as get_crm_record returned it with the record

record_id.description: the id of the record, as returned by find_person_in_crm or search_crm; read it with get_crm_record first

remove_emails.description: person: e-mail addresses to remove; only addresses that get_crm_record showed can be removed

remove_phones.description: person: phone numbers to remove; only numbers that get_crm_record showed can be removed

name: update_crm_record

changed.description: what was changed, in plain words

skipped.description: changes the CRM did not take, with the reason

url.description: link to the record in the CRM

title: Update a CRM record
